title: CloudRF template
description: A CloudRF radio template as stored in this folder and exchanged with the /template endpoints of the CloudRF API. Limits and enumerations follow CloudRF API 3.36 (https://api.cloudrf.com/openapi.json).

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor validation.

version.description: API version the template was created with, eg. `CloudRF API 3.36`. Older exports use `CloudRF-API 3.34` or `CloudRF-API-v3.8.10`.

reference.description: An online reference which can be used to look up what each of the values in the template mean.

site.description: Site name. For a radio template this is the OEM model name.

network.description: Network name/group. For a radio template this is the OEM's name.

engine.description:
Processing engine to handle the request:
* `1` - GPU (requires a GPU enabled server)
* `2` - CPU

coordinates.description:
The coordinates system associated with the template:
* `1` - Decimal Degrees
* `2` - Degrees Minutes Seconds
* `3` - MGRS / UTM

customIcon.description: Optional map icon for the site as an image data URI.

template.description: Metadata about the template which can be used to identify it and make better use of it.

created_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp of when the template was created.

owner.description: The template creator/owner. `CloudRF` for system templates, or the numeric user ID for templates downloaded from the API.

bom_value.description: Value of the template which can be used as part of a bill of materials. Older exports use an empty string when unset.

lat.description: Latitude of transmitter in WGS84 decimal degrees.

lon.description: Longitude of transmitter in WGS84 decimal degrees.

alt.description: Altitude of transmitter above ground level in `metric` or `imperial`. Distance unit set in `output` object.

txw.description: Transmitter power before the antenna, in the unit given by `powerUnit`. The limits below apply to watts.

bwi.description:
Bandwidth in MHz.
* 1MHz has a noise floor of -114dBm
* 10MHz has a noise floor of -104dBm
* 20MHz has a noise floor of -101dBm

powerUnit.description: The RF power unit being used, either `W` or `dBm`.

lat.description: Latitude of receiver in WGS84 decimal degrees. `0` for an area calculation.

lon.description: Longitude of receiver in WGS84 decimal degrees. `0` for an area calculation.

alt.description: Altitude of receiver above ground level in `metric` or `imperial`. Distance unit set in `output` object.

rxg.description: Receiver antenna gain in dBi. Ignored by the RADAR propagation model (`pm` value `8`).

rxs.description: Receiver sensitivity/threshold in measured units. Measured units set by `out` in the `output` object, eg. dBm for received power or dB for SNR.

flt.description: The feeder line type. Older exports store this as a numeric string.

fcc.description: The feeder line number of connectors.

mode.description:
The type of antenna which is being used:
* `template` is a pre-defined pattern identified by `ant`.
* `custom` is a custom pattern built from `hbw`, `vbw` and `fbr`.

txg.description: Transmitter antenna gain in dBi. A half-wave dipole has a gain of 2.15dBi.

ant.description:
Antenna pattern code:
* `0` - Custom pattern (see `hbw`, `vbw`, `fbr`)
* `1` - Vertical dipole (omni-directional)
* Other values are the identifier of a pattern in the antenna database.

azi.description: Antenna azimuth in degrees North. Up to 20 azimuths can be given as a comma-separated list, eg. `0,120,240`.

tlt.description: Antenna tilt in degrees below the horizon (inverted) where horizon is `0`.

hbw.description: Custom antenna horizontal beamwidth in degrees. For use only with `ant` value of `0`.

vbw.description: Custom antenna vertical beamwidth in degrees. For use only with `ant` value of `0`.

fbr.description: Front-to-back ratio measured in dB. A highly directional antenna will have a high FBR.

pm.description:
Propagation model:
* `1` - Irregular Terrain Model (ITM) (Longley-Rice)
* `2` - Line of Sight (LOS)
* `3` - Okumura-Hata
* `4` - ITU-R P.1812
* `5` - SUI Microwave
* `6` - COST231-Hata
* `7` - ITU-R P.525 (Free space path loss)
* `8` - RADAR
* `9` - Ericsson 9999
* `10` - General Purpose
* `11` - Egli VHF/UHF
* `12` - HF NVIS
* `13` - HF Skywave

pe.description:
Propagation model subtype (environment):
* `1` - Conservative (Urban)
* `2` - Average (Suburban)
* `3` - Optimistic (Rural)

ked.description:
Knife edge diffraction for enhancing models with NLOS coverage:
* `0` - Diffraction disabled
* `1` - Knife-edge diffraction
* `2` - Bullington diffraction
* `3` - Giovanelli diffraction
* `4` - Deygout diffraction
* `5` - Epstein-Peterson diffraction

rel.description: Model reliability (aka fade margin) represented as a percentage (%) where 50% adds 0dB loss, 99% adds 9.9dB loss.

rcs.description: RADAR cross section in square meters. Only accepted when `pm` is `8` (RADAR).

month.description: HF Skywave only - Month of the year.

hour.description: HF Skywave only - Hour of the day.

sunspots_r12.description: HF Skywave only - Average international sunspot number.

elevation.description:
Elevation:
* `1` - Digital Surface Model (DSM)
* `2` - Digital Terrain Model (DTM)

buildings.description:
Global OSM buildings layer to enhance DTM:
* `0` - Disabled
* `1` - Enabled

units.description:
Distance units applied to heights and distances:
* `m` - Meters and kilometers above ground level
* `m_amsl` - Meters and kilometers above mean sea level
* `f` - Feet and miles above ground level
* `f_amsl` - Feet and miles above mean sea level

col.description: Colour schema filename, eg. `RAINBOW.dBm`, or a numerical colour schema code. The unit suffix should match the measured unit set by `out`.

out.description:
Measured units:
* `1` - Path loss (dB)
* `2` - Received power (dBm)
* `3` - Field strength (dBuV)
* `4` - Signal-to-Noise Ratio (dB) - uses `nf`
* `5` - Bit-Error-Rate (BER) - uses `ber` and `mod`
* `6` - Reference Signal Received Power (dBm)
* `7` - Best site analysis (%)
* `8` - Throughput (Mbps)
* `9` - Throughput (kbps)

ber.description:
Bit-Error-Rate, combined with `mod`:
* `1` - 0.1 / 10e-1
* `2` - 0.01 / 10e-2
* `3` - 0.001 / 10e-3
* `4` - 0.0001 / 10e-4
* `5` - 0.00001 / 10e-5
* `6` - 0.000001 / 10e-6

LoRa Spread Factors, only valid with `mod` value `11`:
* `7` - LoRa SF7 / 5469bps
* `8` - LoRa SF8 / 3125bps
* `9` - LoRa SF9 / 1758bps
* `10` - LoRa SF10 / 977bps
* `11` - LoRa SF11 / 537bps
* `12` - LoRa SF12 / 293bps

mod.description:
Modulation, combined with `ber`:
* `1` - 4QAM
* `2` - 16QAM
* `3` - 64QAM
* `4` - 256QAM
* `5` - 1024QAM
* `6` - BPSK
* `7` - QPSK
* `8` - 8PSK
* `9` - 16PSK
* `10` - 32PSK
* `11` - LoRa

nf.description: Noise floor in dBm, used with SNR (`out` value `4`). Either a number, or `database` to use a noise map fitted to stored noise measurements.

res.description: Resolution in meters for produced output.
